messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: abs() in Eigen
parts:
On Wednesday, June 24, 2015 at 7:27:44 PM UTC-4, Ben Goodrich wrote:
On Wed, Jun 24, 2015 at 6:54 PM, Arya Pourzanjani <apourz...@evidation.com> wrote:
That's good news! Does this just mean I can download your branch that implements pseudo-eigendecomposition and go to work? I would have to create a function in my Stan model file that computes the matrix exponential of the block diagonal matrix, but that doesn't sound too difficult.

Not quite. We really need an unwritten patch to Eigen first because my local implementation was for a generalized eigenvalue problem rather than a plain eigenvalue problem.

When I go to try this out, I get compiler errors starting with

In file included from test/unit/math/rev/mat/fun/pseudoeigendecomposition_test.cpp:1:                                                                                                           
In file included from ./stan/math/prim/mat/meta/get.hpp:4:                                                                                                                                      
In file included from ./stan/math/prim/mat/fun/Eigen.hpp:4:                                                                                                                                     
In file included from ../eigen_3.2.4/Eigen/Dense:7:                                                                                                                                             
In file included from ../eigen_3.2.4/Eigen/Eigenvalues:30:                                                                                                                                      
../eigen_3.2.4/Eigen/src/Eigenvalues/EigenSolver.h:393:25: error: no matching function for call to 'abs'                                                                                        
        Scalar z = sqrt(abs(p * p + m_matT.coeff(i+1, i) * m_matT.coeff(i, i+1)));

In other words, Eigen is trying to take the square root of the absolute value of a var and has "no known conversion from 'const stan::math::var' to" anything abs() knows about. It works if the input matrix just has doubles. So, how do I tell it to use our abs()? I already put #include <stan/math/rev/scal/fun/abs.hpp> into the top and put using stan::math::abs inside the body of the function before anything in Eigen is called.

Ben

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: abs() in Eigen
parts:
Nevermind, I was #including the wrong thing. Now it compiles and segfaults.

Ben
